threat_event: Ransomware encrypts IT systems, SCADA masters, and packing site systems across several regions during a harvest or freeze season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agriculture and food is a frequent ransomware target; large attack surface (about 12,700 endpoints and tablets, about 64 sites, about 45,500 OT and IoT devices); acquisition and OT vendor gaps (see R-003, R-004, R-005)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-12; all tier-1 processes (P05)
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 PR.PS-05; RC.RP-01 (benchmark); SP 800-82r3 6.4.4; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of IT endpoints; PAM; immutable cloud backups; SCADA configuration and PLC program backups at DC-1 and DC-2; manual irrigation and freeze procedures; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Close acquisition gaps (R-003; POAM-013); move INT-4 and INT-5 onto the OT gateway (POAM-004); SCADA master restore within RTO (POAM-011); enterprise ransomware exercise with OT outage and the disclosure committee (POAM-012)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; OT vendor sessions outside the gateway; SCADA restore time in DR tests

threat_event: Payroll, H-2A worker, and grower files are stolen during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large personal data stores (payroll exports with Social Security and bank account numbers, H-2A passport and visa data, grower contracts); egress monitoring tuned for known patterns only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-11 exports; data warehouse; file shares; SL-1 grower data
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(3)-(4) (worked example; each state where affected individuals reside); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Data loss prevention on email and web; egress alerting; masked worker identifiers in the warehouse
treatment_plan: Egress anomaly models for cloud storage and file shares; remove payroll exports from file shares; data minimization in the warehouse (R-053)
key_risk_indicator: Large outbound transfers investigated; files with worker identifiers on shares

threat_event: Attacker enters through an AQ-01 farm office flat network and reaches enterprise systems over the legacy site VPN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 AQ-01 farm offices on flat networks and legacy firewalls; legacy directory; a VPN rule allowed reach into the R4 historian collector (P07 SC-7 finding)
affected_asset_or_process: AQ-01 farms; R4 control center; enterprise network
existing_controls: Legacy firewalls; EDR on AQ-01 servers since 2026-04
treatment_plan: Remove the VPN rule and restrict to named hosts (done 2026-09-04); SD-WAN migration of AQ-01 offices; identity federation (POAM-013; POAM-001)
key_risk_indicator: AQ-01 offices on SD-WAN; AQ identities federated

threat_event: Attacker uses an integrator's own remote tool (INT-4 or INT-5) to reach pump station PLCs and HMIs and change pump, pivot, or fertigation settings
threat_source: Cybercriminal group or state-aligned actor; compromised integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: INT-4 and INT-5 connect outside the OT remote access gateway to about 120 pump stations, including R3 freeze stations; no MFA or session recording; agreements lack security terms
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 pump stations and HMIs in R3 and R4; BP-01; BP-02
existing_controls: Gateway for INT-1 to INT-3; firewall rules limit integrator tools to specific stations; SOC alerting on new remote sessions
treatment_plan: Move INT-4 and INT-5 onto the gateway, remove their tools, and amend agreements with security terms (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Remote sessions outside the gateway per month; integrator agreements with security terms

threat_event: Former AQ-02 staff or an attacker uses shared logins in the pivot manufacturer's cloud service to stop, start, or reverse about 180 AQ-02 pivots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared logins with no MFA; service outside the OT gateway and SIEM; no security terms or SOC report (P04 finding 2)
existing_controls: Passwords changed at closing (2026-03); manual operation at the panel
treatment_plan: Interim named accounts with MFA in the vendor service (2026-11-15); migrate AQ-02 pivots onto company SCADA (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Shared accounts in the pivot service; pivots migrated to SCADA

threat_event: A fertigation or chemigation injection rate, duration, or interlock setting is changed without approval, exposing workers or contaminating a water source
threat_source: Malicious insider, attacker with operator access, or engineer error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The FMIS planner role can both edit and release recipes (19 users); 6 of 40 sampled OT changes lacked approval; integrity checks do not run at INT-4 and INT-5 stations
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 fertigation and chemigation skids (about 140); BP-01
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 PR.PS-01; DE.CM-09 (benchmark); SP 800-82r3 5.3.1; N11-R01 (voluntary food defense checklist; 21 CFR 121 does not apply)
existing_controls: Hardwired interlocks (backflow check, injection stop on low flow) verified each season; recipe limits in SCADA; SOC alert on recipe change outside a change window
treatment_plan: Split the planner role (POAM-007); approval enforcement and automated blocking (POAM-006); library comparison at all stations and automatic injection stop on mismatch (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: Unapproved OT changes; stations with integrity comparison

threat_event: Freeze protection does not start on a freeze night because the automation, alarm path, or field link fails during a cyber or technical event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Short window between trigger temperature and damage; most freeze pump stations depend on SCADA alarms; R3 freeze stations supported by INT-4

existing_controls: Two-person freeze crews; standalone temperature alarm dialers; licensed radio at most freeze stations; generators at 96 freeze pump stations; November drill
treatment_plan: Add a cyber outage injection (SCADA unavailable) to the November freeze drill (POAM-022); radio coverage for the remaining 11 freeze stations
owner: Vice President, Irrigation and Water Resources
key_risk_indicator: Freeze stations with independent alarm and radio path; drill results
